items.name: Studio Introduction
items.text: Mira is a studio for founders who care how they’re seen. We turn good work into a presence that earns attention — and closes the gap between who you are and how you look.

items.name: Positioning Headline
items.text: WE BUILD BRANDS FOR FOUNDERS WHO REFUSE TO BLEND IN. FEWER PROJECTS, MORE ATTENTION, AND A STUDIO SMALL ENOUGH THAT THE PERSON YOU HIRE IS THE PERSON DOING THE WORK.

items.name: Image
items.alt: Portrait of Jin Yuen

items.name: Quote
items.text: “ I started Mira because I kept watching great people lose to worse competitors with better presence. ”

items.name: Small Text
items.text: Design isn't decoration — it's the fastest way to be understood. Every project is built around one question: does this actually move the business forward?
marks: span:Design isn't decoration — it's the fastest way to be understood. Every project is built around one question: {--framer-text-color:var(--token-82d92470-f077-4c9d-9673-709d01132847, rgb(104, 104, 104))}
